title: 心理情報プログラミングⅠ
subtitle: Programing in Psychology and Information Design I
educationalGoal: Complex experimental design and advanced data analysis increasingly require programming skills in psychological research. In this course, students will first set up a programming environment and then learn the fundamentals of computer-based graphics. Through this process, students will acquire the technical skills needed to create psychological experiments on a computer.
advice: Students are expected to prepare a PC environment to use the university LAN. Students should prepare for the following week’s lesson using the class materials.
requiredKnowledge: Basic computer skills. Basic programing skills.
